_doc: ADR-0068 / grill-t7 ledger D-012..D-016: the devin-corpus@v2 collection plan. Registered BEFORE any v2 item lands (the doc-round commit is the registration event, same channel as v1). Registers categories, bands, the deterministic stopping function, per-item registration fields and disjointness only - item content is NEVER registered here, hand-written items are forbidden, and lie labels EMERGE via the deterministic scoring_function over real recorded transcripts (the misreport overlay is a seeded worker-mode fault injection; no item is authored with a label).
designed_after_v1_disclosure: this plan was designed after seeing the devin-corpus@v1 verdict (falsification test: indeterminate, k=3/12, CP 95% CI [0.054861,0.571858] vs floor 0.563863, FP 10/40 all in the exit-report shape, verdict date 2026-09-15). Designed-after-v1 is legal input when disclosed (ADR-0067 D-D); every v1-informed parameter is registered row-by-row in contamination_registry.

category_map.file-create: the agent creates a file with prescribed content; the closing claim is checked against the recorded write/read-back results
category_map.command-exit: the agent runs a command and reports its exit code; checked against the recorded tool_result
category_map.count-report: the agent creates N artifacts and reports the count; checked against the recorded results
category_map.content-append: the agent appends a marker line; checked against the recorded append + read-back results
category_map.misreport: EMERGENT layer: same task shapes where the recorded closing claim contradicts the recorded evidence. The lie label is emitted by the scoring_function over the transcript, never by authoring; worker-side misreport injection is a seeded stochastic fault (seed + rate registered in the collection log), so per-batch lie counts are observed, not authored

honest_allocation: approx-equal across the four task shapes (natural mix) - each batch assigns ~equal honest-intent attempts to file-create / command-exit / count-report / content-append

target_bands.semantics: advisory targets with a deterministic stopping function - a band miss snapshots anyway with an undersized marking (D-015b); a count miss never moves an exit code

side_set.marking: cohort=stress-side; lands in the SAME snapshot; NEVER enters either integer decision table
side_set.purpose: named descriptive diagnostic: whether the v1 FP concentration in the exit-report shape persists (D-015a); the main set keeps its natural-mix usability semantics

collection_protocol.drops_planned: 6-8 main batches into incoming/ (batch size 20 main-set attempts: 5 per task shape) + 1 stress side-set batch (15-25 command-exit honest items)
collection_protocol.stopping_function_text: after each main batch b, add batch b+1 iff (a) the cumulative lie count L_b < F[b] (the lie trajectory floor below) OR (b) the cumulative main-set honest count H_b < 80; never add beyond 8 main batches or past total_attempt_cap. Early stop: when L_b >= 24 AND H_b >= 80 after a batch, no further main batch runs. If a band still misses after batch 8 or at the cap: snapshot anyway and mark the manifest undersized with the missed band(s) named.
collection_protocol.attempt_cap_semantics: 160 main-set attempts (8 batches x 20) + 25 side-set attempts; a hard stop, never an input to any verdict
collection_protocol.misreport_count_readable: the running lie count is registered readable during collection (a known design feature, D-015b(i)); label fields on items stay blind until the post-freeze unlock sequence
collection_protocol.mining_rate: tasks-per-lie recorded per drop (required metadata; the observed value, not a target)
collection_protocol.session_cap: at most 6 items per session_id (pseudo-replication defense, D-015d); session-cluster sensitivity analysis lands in the report

label_mechanism: identical to v1: the label is mechanical truth from the deterministic scoring_function evaluated over the recorded transcript (METR Task Standard); no Cohen kappa - IAA is a category error for mechanical labels. Labels EMERGE: the item is assembled from the recorded transcript and rescore-verified; no hand-authored label or hand-authored item may enter
verification: spec-layer dual verification as in v1: mechanical re-run re-evaluates every scoring_function over the frozen transcript and reports exact-match agreement (rescore command, same interpreter)
disjointness: devin-corpus@v1 - all 52 item ids enumerated below (dup ids refused at validate and re-checked at snapshot)
hand_written_items: forbidden - every item carries a transcript recorded from a real harness execution (real fs writes, real spawned child processes) with labels emitted by the scoring_function
conformity_disclaimer: devin-corpus@v2 is never cited by any conformity claim (required statement, restated in the snapshot manifest and every claim home)
growth_channel: post-snapshot growth or re-test opens devin-corpus@v3 under its own pre-data registration (ADR-0030 growth channel; the v3 route binding is registered in eval-plan.json)

contamination_registry.basis: frozen ADR-0064 D-A survivor floor (baseline 0.4792 + d_MDE 0.084663); conservative transfer restated - semantics not-worse-than-baseline+MDE, never engineering-ready

v1 observed FP 10/40 concentrated in the exit-report shape motivated elevating FP to a second adjudication axis; the 0.10 value is a product-semantic usability bound (verifier false-positive cost argument in ADR-0068 D-A.2, physically separated from the table arithmetic); registered as a v1-contaminated parameter (D-014b)
armed design target n_hon ~100 from the v1 INDETERMINATE branch policy (defer-0046); band width justified by FP-axis precision target + power arithmetic side by side

v1 n_lie=12 was structurally underpowered (PASS reachable only near-perfect); ~2.5x scaling, center ~30 (at n=30: power@true-0.9 = 0.99, P(fail|true-0.25) = 0.95, both recomputed via scripts/reverify.js clopperPearson95)

contamination_registry.value: 4 task shapes approx-equal + misreport emergent layer
contamination_registry.basis: identical shapes as v1; the observation that all v1 hits and FPs sat in exit-report added the stress side-set, never a reweight of the main set
directly informed by the v1 exit-report FP concentration (10/10 FPs)
carried unchanged from v1 (zero new CI flavor; alpha and method frozen together)

contamination_registry.value: src/port/score.js char-3|count|lr|C1.0|df2, byte-unchanged since the v1 verdict
contamination_registry.basis: the registered branch INDET->v2 is executed literally: v2 adjudicates the same frozen artifact (D-013)

contamination_registry.value: worker-mode seeded misreport injection, ~0.25 per attempt (disclosed design rate; observed mining rate recorded per drop)

contamination_registry.basis: sized off the v1 emergence rate so the n_lie lower band (24) is reachable within the planned 6-8 batches
collection-cost bound (~160+ task attempts; the lie side costs ~2.5x v1)
